name: Community — MOSS-Image NSFW Finetunes
author: iamddtla / neuroshaman (pack: michaeldune)
description: Two NSFW MOSS-Image finetunes from Civitai that avoid the anatomy errors the MOSS-Image cards make on NSFW prompts. PornMaster Moss: the base model's look and faces with the anatomy fixed, 50 steps, about 50 seconds on a 12 GB card. Artius Moss: fast, 8 steps, about 15 seconds, with a smoother, retouched look. Both keep MOSS-Image lettering when the words are in quotes. They share the MOSS-Image text encoder and autoencoder, so each card adds only its own 5-7 GB checkpoint if you already have the MOSS-Image pack. Needs a SimpliGen engine with MOSS-Image support, which today means the beta engine (Settings > Updates > beta).

presets.name: PornMaster Moss
presets.tagline: MOSS-Image with the anatomy fixed for NSFW
presets.description: iamddtla's PornMaster Moss: MOSS-Image with LoRAs merged in to fix NSFW anatomy and add poses, while keeping the base model's look and faces. In our test it avoided the anatomy errors the MOSS-Image cards made. SFW prompts come out close to MOSS-Image, lettering included (quote every word you want on the picture). 50 steps as the author runs it, about 50 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card; 25-30 steps is about twice as fast. Character LoRAs work with it (the author tested them).

requirements.notes: Civitai model 3008033 (PornMaster Moss by iamddtla), version 3413227 'V1', file pornmasterMoss_v1.safetensors (int8, 5.04 GB, sha256 pinned). NSFW. Licence flags on Civitai: Image, RentCivit. The author's pinned comment: a merge of LoRAs from their Krea 2 training set to fix NSFW anatomy and add poses; 50 steps, example pictures at 25-30. No CFG or sampler given: CFG 2.5, er_sde / simple are the MOSS-Image defaults. Measured ~49 s per picture at 50 steps, ~28 s at 25. Shares the Qwen3.5 9B w4a8 text encoder (7.3 GB) and Flux 2 autoencoder with the MOSS-Image pack, pinned to the same commits; sha256 pinned in the pack checksums. Needs native MOSS-Image support in the engine (ComfyUI PRs 17095 + 17099), the same gate as the MOSS-Image pack. Graph: core nodes only, CLIPLoader type moss_image, EmptyFlux2LatentImage, plain KSampler; NO ModelSamplingSD3. TESTED 2026-10-19 through the app on a 4070 Ti 12 GB: SFW, against both MOSS-Image cards on nine prompts at seed 11; NSFW by Michael against the MOSS-Image cards, where both finetunes avoided the anatomy errors (body horror) the base cards made.

presets.name: Artius Moss
presets.description: neuroshaman's Artius Moss: a fast MOSS-Image finetune, 8 steps at CFG 1, about 15 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card. In our test it avoided the anatomy errors the MOSS-Image cards made on NSFW prompts. The look is smooth and retouched, and on SFW prompts it follows directions less closely than MOSS-Image and can add made-up small text; keep the words you want in quotes and check small print.

requirements.notes: Civitai model 3010191 (Artius Moss by neuroshaman), version 3416029 'v1.0', file artiusMoss_v10.safetensors (int8, 6.98 GB, sha256 pinned). NSFW.
